_comment: Data for focus-system/emitters.js. pairingHelpers: shared PHP helpers that pair the selector they are given with a :hover half (or paint the focus half of a hover pair) and paint state, never the keyboard indicator; a statement calling one is shared-state, or shared-shadow when it paints a shadow. entries: a PHP or JS statement the shape rules cannot classify from the file alone, matched by path and a substring of the statement, each with its category and reason. A stale entry (matching no statement) fails --check.

pairingHelpers.name: sgs_hover_state_rules
pairingHelpers.reason: includes/helpers-hover-state.php: emits a touch-guarded :hover rule and an unguarded :focus-visible or :focus-within twin with the same declarations

pairingHelpers.name: sgs_text_colour_gradient_fallback_rule
pairingHelpers.reason: includes/helpers-tokens.php: the text-colour fallback rule for the focus half of a hover colour pair

pairingHelpers.name: sgs_border_gradient_css
pairingHelpers.reason: includes/helpers-tokens.php: a gradient border painted on :hover and its :focus-within twin

pairingHelpers.name: sgs_separators_hover_selectors
pairingHelpers.reason: includes/helpers-separators-hover-css.php: separator selectors for the :hover and :focus states of a list item

pairingHelpers.name: sgs_icon_gradient_states_css
pairingHelpers.reason: includes/helpers-svg-gradient.php: icon gradient fill for the hover state and its keyboard twin

pairingHelpers.name: sgs_emit_state_colour_css
pairingHelpers.reason: includes/helpers-tokens.php: a resting rule and a touch-guarded :hover / :focus-visible colour pair

entries.reason: sgs_button_style_css: the closure builds the :focus-visible half of a hover pair; the hover half is built beside it with SGS_HOVER_NOT_TOUCH and both carry the same hover declarations (or the hover gradient border via sgs_border_gradient_css).
The form Focus state paints only border-color and background-color on .sgs-form-field__input with this suffix; it writes no outline or box-shadow, so the focus system stays the indicator.

field_focus_css: the form field Focus look paints only background-color, border-color and border-width on .sgs-form-field__input:focus; it writes no outline or box-shadow. The ring goes through the override contract on :focus-visible (--sgs-focus-under, --sgs-focus-halo, --sgs-focus-ring), so the focus system stays the indicator.
The editor-canvas twin of class-sgs-motion-focus-state.php: the same border-color and background-color on the same suffix, no outline or box-shadow.
A runtime query (Element.matches(':focus-visible')) that sets data-sgs-nav-has-focus; it paints nothing.
A runtime query (Element.matches(':focus-visible')) in actions.linkTriggerFocus: only keyboard focus on a parent link that is its panel's trigger opens the panel; it paints nothing.
A focus read: submenuOpenOnFocus opens a panel for keyboard-style focus only, so a mouse press or tap never does. It paints nothing.

sgs_link_underline_self_css: The shared link underline for an element that is itself the link (sgs/button, FW-B): rest, hover, keyboard-focus and mouse-focus variants of text-decoration-line, thickness, colour and offset only, so the stylesheet's own hover and focus resets never win. It writes no outline or box-shadow, so the focus system stays the indicator.
